name: @avatark/appearance
description: Canonical appearance-mode registry and product-accent contract. Appearance mode is a user preference; accent is controlled by the mounted product -- these are deliberately separate axes.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
